name: zcode-plugins
description: Official ZCode plugin packages, published for the open-source ZCode build.

plugins.name: android-emulator
plugins.description: Provides Android development workflows and emulator automation for ZCode.

plugins.name: computer-use
plugins.description: Computer Use: automate desktop apps with mouse, keyboard, and UI element control.

plugins.name: documents
plugins.description: DOCX document production skills and a Word viewer panel, published as an official ZCode plugin.

plugins.name: image-search
plugins.description: Official ZCode image search MCP server for finding illustrations and reference images.

plugins.name: ios-simulator
plugins.description: Provides iOS development workflows and simulator automation for ZCode.

plugins.name: pdf
plugins.description: PDF production skills and a PDF viewer panel, published as an official ZCode plugin.

plugins.name: plugin-creator
plugins.description: Develop and validate ZCode plugins through a local dev marketplace, installation, trials and updates.

plugins.name: presentations
plugins.description: PPTX presentation production skills and a PowerPoint viewer panel, published as an official ZCode plugin.

plugins.name: restore-legacy-sessions
plugins.description: Restore and migrate legacy ACP sessions into current ZCode sessions.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Create, evaluate and iterate ZCode skills interactively.

plugins.name: spreadsheets
plugins.description: XLSX spreadsheet production skills and an Excel viewer panel, published as an official ZCode plugin.

plugins.name: visualize
plugins.description: Create interactive explanations, charts and design previews in ZCode conversations.

plugins.name: zcode-guide
plugins.description: ZCode usage guidance, diagnostics and best-practice answers.

plugins.name: browser-use
plugins.description: Built-in browser automation runtime and guidance for Desktop IAB and explicitly enabled CLI-managed headless CDP: open, navigate, inspect, click, type, screenshot, record workspace WebM videos, and verify web pages and local dev targets.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design workflow for UI, web, app prototypes and HTML decks, delivered as workspace files.

plugins.name: document-skills
plugins.description: Built-in DOCX and PDF document production skills, published as an official ZCode plugin.

plugins.name: node-repl-host
plugins.description: Shared node_repl runtime host for ZCode official capabilities. Not user-facing: it carries no skill and appears in no marketplace listing; Browser Use and Computer Use enable it and contribute their own skills, docs and runtime assets.

plugins.name: zcode-site
plugins.description: Publish new or throwaway web projects to ZCode Sites for a quick preview or share link, and manage the site.
